purpose: Closure record for the planned v4 H2 additive repair round. The planned repair (one fixture invalid solely via a schema `pattern` violation, run as a new KNOWN fault) was found to be impossible without a BREAKING canonical-schema change. This record freezes the evidence and the decision analysis. It is NOT a repair round, NOT held-out evidence, NOT independent verification, and NOT certification. No corpus fixture, manifest entry, schema, or fault manifest was added or modified by this investigation.

investigated_fault.mutation: strip every `pattern` keyword from the canonical schema before validation

reproduced_known_gate.note: survivors are the deliberately classified ones in frozen-authority.json ci_gate

reproduced_heldout_without_consumer.note: H2 survivor reproduced on main @ 3270b83; H1 unrelated-failure is the pre-declared witness-direction misprediction preserved verbatim from v3; H3 skipped (consumer adapter not attached in this reproduction)

zero_pattern_analysis.pattern_keyword_count_in_schemas_dir: only mcp-posture / compliance rollout-wire / agentbom schemas declare `pattern`; none of them is the corpus canonical schema
zero_pattern_analysis.method: deep-copy the canonical schema, recursively pop every `pattern` key (the exact transform the H2 mutation injects), compare canonical-form JSON equality with the original: equal

historical_reports_unchanged.note: each file is touched only by the commit that created it; no post-merge rewrite

finding.statement: The canonical AEP record schema declares ZERO `pattern` constraints. The H2 mutation (strip every `pattern` keyword from the canonical schema) is therefore an IDENTITY transform at this contract version: the mutant computes exactly the same function as the unmutated verifier on every possible input, not just on corpus inputs. No fixture can be invalid solely via a `pattern` violation, because the contract contains no `pattern` rule to violate.
finding.reclassification_assessment: The v3 classification `corpus-discrimination-gap` ("no fixture is invalid solely via a pattern violation") is factually true but understates the situation: the corpus is not missing a fixture, the contract is missing the feature. Under the declared survivor_classes vocabulary this is the `equivalent-mutant` class (same class as L1-2). The v3 report file itself remains immutable historical evidence; any reclassification is a NEW statement in THIS record and requires maintainer ratification (needs-review).
finding.repair_blocker: The planned repair requires a `pattern` constraint to exist in schemas/aep/aep-record.schema.json. Adding one (e.g. a non-empty run_id pattern) tightens schema acceptance: per docs/CONTRACT-CHANGE-PROCESS.md section 1, "Tighten a constraint (narrow enum, stricter pattern)" is a BREAKING change requiring a major version bump, new schema version, an org RFC, a release-ledger announcement before merge, and consumer tracking issues. It also requires the consumer schema copy (wasmagent-js packages/aep/schemas/aep-record.schema.json) to gain the identical constraint to stay Gate-B clean. A closure round scoped as "finite, no unrelated expansion" cannot carry that, and a round that silently reclassified the schema edit as corpus-only would make a later certification_reason=["corpus-change"] dishonest.

resolution_options.option: A — ratify equivalent-mutant reclassification (no schema change)
resolution_options.action: Record H2 as equivalent-mutant at contract version aep/v0.5 (this record + maintainer sign-off); close the H2 gap as a classification correction, not a repair. If the contract later gains pattern constraints in a breaking-contract round, H2 becomes a live known fault again and the additive fixture path opens.
resolution_options.certification_impact: no corpus change, no certification trigger from this workstream

resolution_options.option: B — schedule the breaking schema change as its own round
resolution_options.action: Run the full CONTRACT-CHANGE-PROCESS.md section 3 path (RFC, release ledger, major bump, consumer copy + tracking issues), then perform the v4 additive repair exactly as planned, then certify with an honestly broader certification_reason (schema-change and corpus-change).
resolution_options.certification_impact: certification_reason must include schema-change; a corpus-change-only label would be dishonest
